name: Aastha Vishwakarma
title: Advocate
tagline: Advocate appearing before the High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital, the Delhi High Court, the District Courts of Delhi and Nainital, and tribunals.
summary: Aastha Vishwakarma is an advocate appearing before the High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital, the Delhi High Court, the District Courts of Delhi and Nainital, the NCLAT and the Central Administrative Tribunal, with an office in Haldwani. Her practice covers service and education law, civil and criminal litigation in the district courts including cheque bounce and recovery matters, matrimonial and family disputes, writ petitions against public authorities, criminal appeals and white-collar defence, property and land, insolvency and tribunal matters. She is enrolled with the Bar Council of Uttarakhand (enrolment no. UK104/2018).
